name: Riverside
description: Riverside lets agents search recording transcripts, make clips, and edit recordings in the studios of the signed-in user. It needs a Riverside Grow plan or higher.

prompts.text: Find where my guest talked about pricing in last week's episode.
Suggest three short clips from my latest recording.
Summarize the transcript of my most recent recording.

apps.name: Riverside
apps.description: Recordings, clips, and transcripts, over Riverside's MCP server with browser sign-in.
